metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the fish, the talk at breakfast, Anne's sheet in the chest, and the Verona page.

yesterday: Breakfast was threepence. Mistress Ansell said two houses alike is no plot.
Anne's sheet is in the chest.
The page still says the King comes first.
The friar's name is on the page. Tomorrow is a clear board, if you mean it, and a walk, if the legs want one.
